# LSTE - Luxembourg Software Testing Event

> Luxembourg's annual software testing and QA conference, organised by Q-Leap.
> 8th edition: 26 November 2026, 13:00-21:00,
> Hôtel Parc Belle-Vue, Luxembourg City. Free to attend, registration required.
> Running since 2014. 280+ attendees at the 6th edition (2024).
> Not a general tech conference: one afternoon dedicated to software testing
> and quality, for practitioners from Luxembourg, France, Belgium and Germany.

## Pages prioritaires

- [Accueil](https://www.lste.lu/) : l'événement, la date, le lieu, l'inscription gratuite
- [Billetterie](https://www.lste.lu/register/) : inscription gratuite, contenu du ticket, FAQ
- [Programme](https://www.lste.lu/schedule/) : déroulé de la journée
- [Lieu](https://www.lste.lu/venue/) : adresse, accès, transports, accessibilité
- [Appel à speakers](https://www.lste.lu/call-for-speakers/) : candidatures jusqu'au 30/09/2026
- [Devenir sponsor](https://www.lste.lu/become-a-sponsor/) : formules et audience
- [Éditions passées](https://www.lste.lu/previous-editions/) : historique depuis 2014
- [Presse](https://www.lste.lu/press/) : couverture média
